sloka: तस्मिंस्तु धरणी देवी बाहुभ्यां गृह्य मैथिलीम् ।स्वागतेनाभिनन्द्यैनामासने चोपवेशयत् ।। ७.९७.२० ॥
transliteration: tasmiṁstu dharaṇī devī bāhubhyāṁ gṛhya maithilīm ।svāgatenābhinandyaināmāsane copaveśayat ।। 7.97.20 ॥

translations.english: Then, Goddess Earth, taking Maithili with her two arms, greeted her with a welcome and made her sit upon that throne.
